about: Saves a file built in the page, such as an export of the records on screen. The trigger is the library's `Button`, so it takes every button axis. The contents of the file come from the page itself.

built.about: `data` is a function the trigger calls on each press. This one compresses 20,000 rows with gzip and returns a promise of the file. While the promise is pending, a spinning `Icon` named Compressing replaces the download icon. The trigger is `aria-disabled` in that state, so it keeps focus, and its `onClick` cancels a second press with `preventDefault`.
built.title: Built on press

kinds.about: A CSV ledger, JSON totals and an SVG mark, each saved under its own name and `mimeType`. An icon-only trigger takes `aria-label` and `shape="square"`. The size column reads the byte length of each file.
kinds.title: Kinds of file

lone.about: A trigger with visible text saves the ledger as a CSV file. `data` is text in the page, and `mimeType` gives it a type.
lone.title: Download button

menu.about: A menu row is not a button, so the menu's `onSelect` calls `download` with the chosen format. `download` takes the trigger's options and returns a promise.
menu.title: From a menu

title: Download trigger
